title: A bad order: 4 colors where 2 would do
notes: Four pairs, A B, C D, E F and G H, and every vertex is joined to every other vertex except its partner. The graph has no odd cycle, so 2 colors are enough. Name order gives each pair a new color: 4.
ops: A-D, A-F, A-H, B-C, B-E, B-G, C-F, C-H, D-E, D-G, E-H, F-G
